prompt: A fitness gym with members and trainers. A personal trainer is spotting a client who is lifting a barbell on a bench. The personal trainer is visibly more muscular than the client. The barbell has two weight plates on it. On the floor nearby is a set of dumbbells, and the number of dumbbells is double the number of weight plates on the barbell. A member is running on a treadmill, wearing headphones and holding a water bottle. In the yoga area, a yoga instructor is demonstrating poses on a mat in front of a mirror. There are a total of three yoga mats in the area. In a corner, a stack of foam rollers is present, and the number of foam rollers is one less than the number of yoga mats. The mirror is taller than the instructor but shorter than the wall. A member is using resistance bands while sitting on an exercise ball. A receptionist is checking in members while typing on a computer behind the front desk. A maintenance worker is cleaning equipment with a spray bottle and wearing rubber gloves.
